{{Quote|Well, guess who's got the fastest ship in the sector?|Nico Okarr|<ref name="Return" />}}
'''Nico Okarr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Captain/Legends#Civilian use|captain]] who achieved great fame in the years before the start of the [[Great Galactic War]]. He was captured during a smuggling run on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] in [[3681 BBY]], but played a pivotal role in helping [[Satele Shan]] and [[Jace Malcom]] escape the [[Battle of Korriban|returned Sith Empire's subsequent attack]]. He escaped custody shortly afterward and seemingly vanished, but thanks to an [[Nico Okarr's Sith artifact|artifact]] he found on Korriban, Okarr survived for [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] without aging a day. In [[3631 BBY]], he was recruited to aid the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against the [[Eternal Empire]], looking no older than he did almost half a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] earlier.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Ever hear about the time I saved Theron's mom?|Nico Okarr recalls his encounter with [[Satele Shan]]|<ref name="KOTFE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>}}
Nico Okarr was one of the most celebrated mercenary spacers in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in the years before the return of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the start of the [[Great Galactic War]]. His debts were as legendary as his deeds, leading Okarr to take the most high-risk and even-higher-reward jobs available in the underworld. No matter the odds, he always delivered the goods, and every criminal syndicate from the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] down competed for his services.<ref name="KOTFE" /> At some point he stole engine schematics from a [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]] [[Seamus Kaldo's father|noble]] to sell to his competitor and used them to upgrade his [[XS stock light freighter/Legends|XS stock light freighter]] ''[[Redshifter]]'' in process.<ref name="Vacation">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20150707|text="Vacation"|int=Vacation}}</ref>

[[File:NicoOkarrBadass-Return.png|thumb|left|250px|Okarr battling Sith forces on [[Korriban's orbital security station]]]]
In [[3681 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline 6">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}}</ref> an astromech droid [[T7-O1]] was assigned by Jedi Master [[Ven Zallow]] to work undercover as Okarr's co-pilot and mechanic. While attempting to smuggle [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] off the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] homeworld of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], Okarr and Teeseven were captured by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces over the planet. The Republic arrested Okarr and impounded the smuggler's ship at the [[Korriban's orbital security station]]. However, Okarr's transfer to a holding cell by [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kao Cen Darach]], his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Satele Shan]], and two [[Jace Malcom|Republic]] [[Republic trooper|troopers]] was interrupted by the arrival of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A massive fleet arrived in-system and launched an offensive against the station, intending to [[Battle of Korriban|retake]] their homeworld. When the Jedi Master decided that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] needed to be warned of the Sith's return, Okarr volunteered the ''Redshifter'' to help them escape and used his two custom [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] to help the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fight off the Sith. After they defeated the [[Imperial soldier|Sith troopers]] guarding the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], two [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] named [[Darth Vindican|Vindican]] and [[Darth Malgus|Malgus]] arrived. While the Jedi confronted the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], Okarr and [[Jace Malcom]], the only remaining Republic trooper, prepared the ship for departure. The smuggler instructed Teeseven, who had been on-board the ship performing maintenance, to prepare the ship's weapons in preparation for their escape. While Master Darach stayed behind to [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] the Sith, his Padawan Satele Shan boarded the ship as it was taking off under the orders of her Master. Okarr then told Shan and the trooper to mount the [[Laser turret/Legends|laser turrets]] to defend against the [[Mark VI Supremacy-class starfighter|Sith interceptors]]. After precisely maneuvering through a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|Sith battlecruiser]], Okarr activated the ship's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to make their escape.<ref name="Return" />

Okarr delivered Shan, Malcom and T7-O1 to warn [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] of the danger, after which he promptly escaped custody again and his trail went cold. With no sightings of him in decades, everyone eventually assumed that Okarr had died, though there was no official record of it.<ref name="KOTFE" /> At some point Nico Okarr settled on a "vacation" on [[Molavar/Legends|Molavar]], spending his time in the [[Sarlacc and Loaded cantina]] under alias "Snare". Eventually, he was approached there by [[Seamus Kaldo]] and his bodyguard [[Vhonu]], who were looking to hire "Snare" to help them locate Nico Okarr and extract vengeance on him for stealing schematics from [[Seamus Kaldo's father|Kaldo's father]] many years ago. After confirming that Kaldo had the money on his person, "Snare" accepted the job and revealed himself as Nico Okarr, asking his payment for delivering the target to Kaldo's table. Having no intentions to pay the man that he was going to bring to justice, Kaldo asked his bodyguard to stun Okarr, but Nico saw this a breach of contract and shot both men on stun setting. He then retrieved his payment from Kaldo's unconscious body and departed Molavar, abandoning "Snare" as the alias.<ref name="Vacation" />

[[File:Nico_Okarr_JMGD.jpg|thumb|240px|Nico Okarr flying his ship]]
By [[3631 BBY]], almost fifty years after being last seen in the larger galaxy, Nico Okarr was touring the cantinas in the [[Spire (Zakuul)|Spire]], the capital city of the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] planet [[Zakuul]]. Rumours of his stay there reached smuggler captain [[Hylo Visz]] who was a member of the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] that opposed Zakuul's [[Eternal Empire]]. Visz asked [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]] to investigate the rumours, who managed to track down and approach Nico Okarr in the [[Platform 6 cantina]] in Zakuul's [[Old World]]. The smuggler recognized the famous galactic figure, but was unable to remember their name on the spot. He was then inquired about how he managed not to age in almost half a century and implied that a [[Nico Okarr's Sith artifact|relic from Korriban]] might be involved. Okarr than asked his potential employee to make him a drink to show their character. Approving of their choice of ingredients, Okarr agreed to work for the Alliance and piloted ''Redshifter'' to the [[Alliance base]] on [[Odessen]]. There, he worked alongside underworld logistics specialist Hylo Visz<ref name="KOTFE" /> and later helped defend the Alliance base during the [[Assault on Odessen]] by Eternal [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Vaylin]].<ref name="KOTET">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Nico Okarr first appeared in [[Return (cinematic trailer)|''Return'']], a cinematic trailer made to advertise ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] by [[BioWare]], where he is voiced by the veteran voice actor [[John DiMaggio]]. The circumstances of his appearance in the trailer were elaborated by ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' and [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']], which also revealed his name for the first time. Nico Okarr later appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']] expansion of the game, released in [[2015]], as a companion character available exclusively to players who were active subscribers on [[August 10]], [[2015]].<ref name="swtor.com">{{TORweb|url=fallen-empire/rewards|text=Knights of the Fallen Empire: Rewards}}</ref> Nico Okarr was later made available for players who were subscribed on [[April 3]], [[2018]].<ref name="Companion Chaos">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20180329|text='COMPANION CHAOS' – THE CHAOS IS OVER, NOW IT'S TIME TO CELEBRATE!}}</ref> The character has also since then been made available to all players as part of Galactic Season 1, following the release of [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|Update 6.3 "The Dark Descent"]].<ref name="Galactic Season">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210426-1|text=Galactic Season 1: The Stranger from Kubindi}}</ref>

His appearance in the game matches that from the ''Return'' trailer, despite taking place almost fifty years later, his improbable age is also mentioned in the ''[[Vacation]]'' short story released on the game's website.<ref name="Vacation" />

[[File:NicoOkarrSWC.jpg|thumb|right|150px|The possible depiction of Okarr in ''Star Wars: Commander'' (right)]]
The [[2014]] [[Canon]] mobile game ''[[Star Wars: Commander]]'' has artwork of a [[Tatooine]] cantina that displays several outlaw patrons, including a [[Human]] who resembles Nico Okarr.<ref name="SWC">''[[Star Wars: Commander]]''</ref>
